name: AI Roadmap v2 Deliverables
tagline: The roadmap as a deck, a report and a tracking workbook.

page.objective: Turn the roadmap into something the studio can actually run against, not just read once.
page.problem: A roadmap that exists only as a presentation stops being true within a month.
page.solution: Three linked deliverables generated from one source: a deck, a landscape report and a workbook that tracks progress.
